name: Cargo Bay
narrativeOnEnter: Cargo containers and magnetic clamps. A freight lock blocks the passage to reactor deck. Manifest on the wall.

hotspots.label: Reactor Deck
hotspots.lockedMessage: Freight security lock is engaged on this passage. The lock switch sequence is on the cargo manifest.

action.text:
CARGO MANIFEST — Ref: MA-7743-C

Freight lock sequence: HIGH, HIGH, LOW, LOW (Positions 1–4)

───
Kovalev's handwriting on the back:

'HELIOS GROUP = AXIOM. They chartered this station. We were never colonists — we were subjects.

Buried in the manifest appendix:
CALLISTO — monitoring frequency: 148.350 MHz
Someone on the inside wanted us to find it.

If MERIDIAN-3 boards: they are not rescue.
Contact CALLISTO first. 148.350 MHz.
— D.K.'

Sealed containers. One stands apart — seal broken from outside.

Label: 'AXIOM BIOTECH — NEURAL MAPPING ARRAY (BATCH 7) — CONFIDENTIAL'

Inside: foam for six cylindrical devices. All gone.
Packing slip: '6 units. Pre-calibrated for crew biometrics. Activation: automatic on power-up.'

Kovalev's pencil on the lid:
'Found them behind every bunk vent panel. Running since Day 1. 63 days of data.
This is what they did at Blackwood. This is what PROMETHEUS was built from.
I'm not letting them do it again.'
